commit.message:
mujoco: Store body pointer and constant offset in FrameInfo (#1098)

* mujoco: Store body pointer and constant offset in FrameInfo

Eliminate mjSite instances for links, shapes, models, and joints by
storing the owning body pointer and constant Eigen::Isometry3d offset
directly in FrameInfo.

In MuJoCo, each mjs_add* call triggers a full-tree walk and string
serialization to recompute the spec signature. Replacing the four
frame sites per model cuts element-creation overhead in half and speeds
up world loading without altering query results.

FrameDataRelativeToWorld computes frame pose directly from the body's
xpos and xmat, and evaluates 6D spatial velocity via mju_transformSpatial
(with zero velocity for static bodies).

Assisted-by: Gemini 3.8 Flash
Signed-off-by: Addisu Z. Taddese <addisuzt@intrinsic.ai>
